from pathlib import Path
import sys, json, hashlib, subprocess
receipt = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes())
source_ref = sys.argv[2] # exact packet commit; WORKTREE only before sealing
def digest(text): return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
for f in receipt["mechanical_inverse"]["files"]:
    raw = (Path(f["path"]).read_bytes() if source_ref == "WORKTREE" else
        subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", source_ref + ":" + f["path"]]))
    assert len(raw) == f["after_bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == f["after_sha256"]
    text = raw.decode("utf-8") # NO newline normalization
    for seam in reversed(f["seams"]):
        assert digest(text) == seam["state_after_sha256"]
        for at in reversed(seam["after_character_offsets"]):
            assert text[at:at+len(seam["after"])] == seam["after"]
            text = text[:at] + seam["before"] + text[at+len(seam["after"]):]
        assert digest(text) == seam["state_before_sha256"]
    restored = text.encode("utf-8")
    base = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", receipt["source_base"] + ":" + f["path"]])
    assert restored == base and len(restored) == f["before_bytes"]
    assert hashlib.sha256(restored).hexdigest() == f["before_sha256"]
    print(f["path"] + " EXACT " + f["before_sha256"])
